'''Ghana Gleemort'''<ref name="CCG" /> was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned and weak-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]]<ref name="Complete Visual" /> who served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]],<ref name="CCG" /> a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated out of a [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A member of the [[Groogrun]] clan,<ref name="EGWT" /> Gleemort was armed with a [[Clan Groogrun vibro-ax]]<ref name="Complete Visual">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and assigned to protect the palace, although the Gamorrean was secretly negotiating with [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr monks]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|345|Gleemort, Ghana}}</ref>&mdash;an ancient order of [[Monk/Legends|monks]] with members traveling the palace<ref name="CSWE monk">{{CSWECite|I|84|B'omarr monks}}</ref>&mdash;regarding his possible defection<ref name="CCG" /> from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] service prior to Jabba's [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ghana Gleemort's name originated in ''[[Tatooine Limited]]'', an expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. His card used an image of a Gamorrean seen in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the third installment of the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="CCG" />

In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' represented the Gamorrean guard [[Gartogg/Legends|Gartogg]] with the image that the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game used to depict Gleemort.<ref name="CSWE Gartogg">{{CSWECite|I|326|Gartogg}}</ref> On [[December 11]], [[2012]],<ref name="Insider">{{SW|url=news/whats-inside-star-wars-insider-138|text=What's Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #138|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Leland Chee]] wrote the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 138|138]] article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Pigs in Space]]," identifying Ghana Gleemort as the Gamorrean guard<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|138|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Pigs in Space!}}</ref> in a photo first used in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> As nothing further clarified if it was Ghana Gleemort or Gartogg who appeared in the ''Return of the Jedi'' film, this article treats ''Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary'' as the first [[in-universe]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' publication to feature the Ghana Gleemort character.
